title: 第17章 返回家族第18章 再见山羊胡子老头
lines: 这次出来，已经有近一个月的时间了，萧羽也是比较担心馨儿，虽然说馨儿在家族内，应该没有什么风险，但是萧羽还是想尽快见到小丫头。
所以萧羽在和弓紫嫣，蛮儿，黑子和赤天歌交待了一下，便是只身返回族中。
萧羽换了身青衫，很快便是来到了家族的，大门口，短短不到的三个月的时间内，萧羽便是从一个毫无用处的废物，成为了可以与家族第一天才萧龙的媲美的天才，所以萧羽早已经成为了家族很多普通弟子的偶像！
门口的弟子看到萧羽站在门前，立刻一脸恭敬的道：“羽少爷好！”
这种待遇还是让萧羽有点不适应，毕竟自己从来都没有被这样尊敬过，不过经过这样一段时间的历练，萧羽早就不是以前那个唯唯诺诺的少年了。
萧羽点了点头，在几个弟子恭敬，崇拜的目光中走了进去！
萧羽径直向后山而去，在家族里他最为关心的就是馨儿这个丫头了，所以萧羽并未在其它地方停留，而是径直向后山而去！
在路上，萧羽发现家族的很多弟子都是身穿练功服，并且很多人都是手执兵刃，对此萧羽虽有疑惑，但是也没有过多在意，萧家毕竟是武道世家！
此时萧家的大殿中，萧家的家主萧海，几位长老还有家族包括萧龙在内的几个小辈也在其中！
“刘家现在是越来越猖獗了！公然打伤我萧家子弟！他们这是想挑起战争！”三长老萧刚愤怒的道。
“家主，最近一个月期间，刘家越界侵占我萧家的黑铁矿已经有三次了，每次我们的弟子都被打伤，如果我萧家不做出反击，那么刘家只会是越来越过分！”二长老萧烈紧跟着道。
萧海揉了揉眉心：“父亲还在闭关之中，不知能否突破！若是我们和刘家直接起了冲突，怕是我们家族不保啊！”
毕竟萧家没有天武境坐镇。在中端战力相等的情况下，高端战力几乎决定了冲突的结果，这个家主还真是难当啊！
萧海不仅想到了自己的四弟，如果他要是还在的话，恐怕这些都不是问题吧？
毕竟在二十年前，那可是一个人压着整个大周帝国年轻一代都抬不起来的绝世妖孽，最后无故失踪，只留下了一个独子——萧羽。
到后来连名字都是成为了禁忌，帝国皇帝竟然亲自颁布圣旨，禁止任何人再提起那个名字：萧战！
父亲也是对四弟的事情决口不提，只是对萧羽这个孩子格外疼爱。
众人并不知道萧海在想什么，只是默不作声。
这时，一个负责消息传递的弟子跑了进来：“报告家主，各位长老！大事不好了。”
萧海的思绪一下被拉了回来：“说，什么事情如此慌张？！
“萧虎少爷被打成了重伤，至今昏迷不醒！”那个弟子躬身道。
此话一出，萧海和萧龙立刻站了起来
“虎儿在哪里？”
“我弟弟在哪里？”
正在这时，浑身是血的萧虎被抬了上来，一个家族药师正在给萧虎进行救治！旁边还有一个妇人在不停的哭泣。
“萧海，你一定要为虎儿讨回公道！”
正是萧海的夫人也是萧龙和萧虎的母亲。
此时萧龙转身向那个弟子问道：“出手的可是刘坤？”
“回少爷，是吴兴！”那个弟子道。
content_en:
It has been nearly a month since she came out this time, and Xiao Yu is also worried about Xin'er. Although Xin'er is within the family and there should be no risk, Xiao Yu still wants to see the little girl as soon as possible.
So Xiao Yu, after explaining to Gong Ziyan, Man'er, Heizi and Chi Tiange, returned to the clan alone.
Xiao Yu changed into a green shirt and soon came to the family's gate. In less than three months, Xiao Yu went from a useless waste to a genius comparable to the family's first genius, Xiao Long. Therefore, Xiao Yu has already become the idol of many ordinary disciples of the family!
When the disciple at the door saw Xiao Yu standing in front of the door, he immediately said respectfully: "Hello, Master Yu!"
This kind of treatment still makes Xiao Yu a little uncomfortable. After all, he has never been respected like this before. However, after such a period of experience, Xiao Yu is no longer the submissive young man he used to be.
Xiao Yu nodded and walked in under the respectful and adoring eyes of several disciples!
Xiao Yu went straight to the back mountain. In the family, the girl Xin'er he cared about the most was, so Xiao Yu did not stop anywhere else, but went straight to the back mountain!
On the way, Xiao Yu found that many disciples of the family were wearing training uniforms, and many of them were holding weapons. Although Xiao Yu was confused about this, he did not pay too much attention to it. The Xiao family is a martial arts family after all!
At this time, in the main hall of the Xiao family, the head of the Xiao family, Xiao Hai, several elders and several junior members of the family, including Xiao Long, were also there!
"The Liu family is getting more and more rampant now! They openly injure my children of the Xiao family! They want to provoke a war!" Xiao Gang, the third elder, said angrily.
"Master, in the past month, the Liu family has crossed the border and occupied the black iron mines of my Xiao family three times. Each time our disciples were injured. If our Xiao family does not fight back, then the Liu family will only go further and further!" Xiao Lie, the second elder, followed closely.
Xiao Hai rubbed his eyebrows: "Father is still in seclusion, I don't know if he can break through! If we have a direct conflict with the Liu family, I'm afraid our family will not be safe!"
After all, the Xiao family does not have the Tianwu realm in charge. When the mid-range combat power is equal, the high-end combat power almost determines the outcome of the conflict. It is really difficult to be the head of this family!
Xiao Hai not only thought of his fourth brother, but if he was still alive, I'm afraid these wouldn't be a problem, right?
After all, twenty years ago, he was a peerless evildoer who could not lift up the younger generation of the entire Zhou Empire. He disappeared without any reason, leaving only an only son - Xiao Yu.
Later, even the name became taboo, and the emperor himself issued an edict forbidding anyone to mention that name again: Xiao Zhan!
The father also never mentioned anything about his fourth brother, but he loved Xiao Yu very much.
Everyone didn't know what Xiao Hai was thinking, so they just remained silent.
At this time, a disciple who was responsible for delivering the news ran in: "Report to the family head, elders! Something serious has happened."
Xiao Hai's thoughts were suddenly pulled back: "Tell me, why are you so panicked?!
"Master Xiao Hu was beaten seriously and is still unconscious! "The disciple bowed and said.
As soon as these words came out, Xiao Hai and Xiao Long stood up immediately
"Where is Hu'er? "
"Where is my brother? "
At this moment, Xiao Hu, who was covered in blood, was carried up, and a family pharmacist was treating Xiao Hu! There was a woman beside him who was crying.
"Xiao Hai, you must seek justice for Hu'er! "
It is Xiao Hai's wife who is also the mother of Xiao Long and Xiao Hu.
At this time, Xiao Long turned around and asked the disciple: "Is it Liu Kun who made the move? "
"Back to the young master, it's Wu Xing! "The disciple said.
